accountBackgroundTasksHelp: Background calls that create, update, or clean cache entries. They are not user generation requests and may temporarily occupy the account.

accountStatusHelp_cooldown: Temporarily paused after a rate limit or repeated failures. Recovery can start after the cooldown.
accountStatusHelp_disabled: No new automatic requests. Individual tests are allowed. Manually enabling cancels the old restore plan.
accountStatusHelp_draining: Finishing the current task before this account stops serving requests.
accountStatusHelp_duplicate: Another credential file represents the same account. This duplicate does not occupy an extra slot.

accountStatusHelp_excluded: This account is not currently selected for automatic request handling.
accountStatusHelp_finishing: Generation has ended; the response is being returned or cleaned up.

accountStatusHelp_preparing: Updating or cleaning the cache. Generation can continue after this background task finishes.
accountStatusHelp_queued: Requests are waiting for this account to become idle.
accountStatusHelp_ready: The browser is connected and idle. This account can receive a generation request.
accountStatusHelp_reauth: The sign-in credentials have expired. Sign in again or upload valid credentials.
accountStatusHelp_recovering: Restoring the browser connection. New generation requests cannot start yet.
accountStatusHelp_retrying: The last startup failed. After the retry time, the system can try again when it needs another account.
accountStatusHelp_stale: Status refresh failed. Current account states are unknown. Refresh to retry.
accountStatusHelp_standby: The browser is not running. This is a spare account; the system may start it when capacity is needed.
accountStatusHelp_starting: Opening the browser and connecting to AI Studio. Requests can start after setup finishes.
accountStatusHelp_testing: A real test request is running on this account.
accountStatusHelp_unknown: Request availability is unknown. Refresh the status or expand details to investigate.
accountStatusHelp_verify_pending: The connection is back. One real request is needed to confirm that generation works.
accountStatusHelp_verifying: One real generation request is checking recovery. Normal service resumes after it succeeds.

accountTestReason_access_denied: Upstream returned 401 or 403: check login and model access.

accountTestReason_cancelled: The test was cancelled and does not establish account usability.
accountTestReason_connection_lost: The browser connection was lost before a complete reply arrived.
accountTestReason_cooldown: The account is cooling down. Wait until retry is allowed; no request was sent.

accountTestReason_disabled: Automatic requests are disabled. Use the account test button for an individual check.

accountTestReason_rate_limited: Upstream returned 429: this account or model is currently rate limited.
